title: Switch-on check: hub lines hold only W14; planned hubs and other states' sources stop holding Start; the pre-flight includes the switch-on check
why: After Start (18:44 UTC) the check held the master on 20 'Opening a geo-hub' lines. Three causes: a hub with no stage row counted as Open; a hub with no recorded state was checked against every state's sources; and the hub lines held everything. Now a hub's stage comes from hubs.status when none is set; a hub's sources are its own states' (its micro-clusters' zips), none when no state is known; and the hub lines hold W14 only (Jason, 2026-11-17; 0163 §10's note; 0170 §2: a hub's stage is about support, never data). The pre-flight gains 'Start the system's switch-on check: no red line that holds everything', needed for launch.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
Put on staging (2 files); its checks passed.
